name: Pongsatorn Jongwilas
bio: Phuak Pongsatorn Jongwilas is a Thai actor and DJ. He went to Kasetsart University in Bangkok where he graduated with a major in Journalism. He's been a close friend of Bo Thanakorn Chinakul since elementary school. Presently, Phuak is a DJ at 94 EFM and the owner of LOLLIPOP®, a kids' fashion line.

credits.title: Inherit
credits.overview: Follows a wealthy family whose polished exterior begins to crack when an ancient centipede spirit infiltrates their bloodline.

credits.title: 404 Run Run
credits.overview: Nakrob, a young real estate swindler, discovers an abandoned hillside hotel by the beach. Seeing an opportunity, he decides to turn it into a luxury hotel scam.

credits.title: How to Make Millions Before Grandma Dies
credits.overview: M, a university dropout low on money and luck, volunteers to take care of his terminally ill grandmother, in the hope of pocketing an inheritance.

credits.title: The Adventures
credits.overview: Joy, a secretary at a large multinational company, has an online shopping problem, likes to read adventure novels and watch travel and adventure shows. She daydreams about living a life of adventure.

credits.title: Ghost Rookie
credits.overview: Because no one has ever died, Win, a young man who had just died, had to become a Ghost Rookie. He accidentally came across Fah Klai, the goddess, whose shrine was about to be destroyed, but for some reason, it caused him to make every effort to help the shrine remain.

credits.title: Happy Ending
credits.overview: An account of five couples, five stories of different overlapping life events told through the story of a young writer and a girl he meets.

credits.title: My Boss is a Serial Killer
credits.overview: Two office employees learn that their boss is a serial killer and must prove his guilt before they become his next victims.

credits.title: The Con-Heartist
credits.overview: Ina, whose ex-boyfriend runs off, leaving her in debt, manages to catch on a cunning con artist who tries to con her. But instead of turning him to the police, she hires this con artist to swindle her ex-boyfriend to get revenge.

credits.title: Tootsies & The Fake
credits.overview: After knocking a celebrity unconscious before a huge job, a bumbling pack of pals tries to avoid a lawsuit by replacing her with a look-alike.

credits.title: Homestay
credits.overview: When a spirit inhabits the body of a teen named Min, he begins to settle into his life until he's forced to find out who caused Min's mysterious death.

credits.title: Mr. Hurt
credits.overview: Don Sri-Chang, a tennis professional and world champion, is left heartbroken when his girlfriend turns down his marriage proposal and dates a rockstar. Dew, his long-lost friend, turns up out of nowhere to help him with the heartbreak.

credits.title: The Making - Is This Story About Nak or Mak?
credits.overview: ABS-CBN documentary about the 2013 film Pee Mak and an exploration about whether it is Nak's story or Mak's.

credits.title: Pee Mak
credits.overview: Mak's friends just want to protect him, but his wife Nak won't let a small thing like her own death get in the way of true love.

credits.title: Seven Something
credits.overview: Three modern love stories focus on how digital privacy, fleeting fame and the power of personal reinvention can change one's romantic destiny.

credits.title: ATM
credits.overview: Two enamoured employees in a bank with no fraternization policy must recover their company's lost money while trying to keep their relationship a secret.

credits.title: Hello Stranger
credits.overview: Two strangers meet in South Korea, each on a vacation.  When he misses his tour bus, he asks a woman if he can hang out with her for a few days. They have fun together, but never tell each other their names.  So when the trip is over they don't know how to contact each other.

credits.title: Secret Sunday
credits.overview: Nat is forced to explore nine different temples in order to clean up his karma. Unfortunately, his karma affects his travel companions' karma too.

credits.title: Phobia 2
credits.overview: An anthology of five macabre short stories about hungry ghosts, comatose brain dead, a group of bright-eyed actors, an unscrupulous car salesman, and careless backpack tourists.

credits.title: 4bia
credits.overview: Four directors create short films based on unique fears involving a lonely woman, a princess's corpse, a haunted camping trip and a cursed manuscript.

credits.title: My Space
credits.overview: Surrounded by loneliness, Paan is searching for what she's doing in each days. Until she meets Nick, the guy next door who is an artist, he begins a conversation and they start to learn the meaning of life from each other.
